# PetDate

> PetDate (پت‌دیت) is the Persian pet playmate, pet shop, adoption, and online vet-consult platform. Web and Telegram share one account.

PetDate helps pet owners in Iran find playmates (همبازی) for dogs and cats, browse the pet shop (پت‌شاپ), discover pets available for adoption (پذیرش), and request online veterinary consultation (مشاوره دامپزشک). Primary language is Persian (fa) with an RTL interface. Playmate chat and checkout require login. Veterinary support is online consultation, not a clinic directory.

## Pages

- [Home](https://petdate.ir/): landing page
- [FAQ](https://petdate.ir/faq): frequently asked questions
- [Pet shop](https://petdate.ir/shop): public catalog
- [Vet consult](https://petdate.ir/vet-consult): online veterinary consultation
- [Adoption](https://petdate.ir/adoption): adoption listings
- [Magazine](https://petdate.ir/magazine): articles
- [OTP login](https://petdate.ir/auth/login): sign in
- [XML sitemap](https://petdate.ir/sitemap.xml): crawl map
- [Full AI summary](https://petdate.ir/llms-full.txt): longer machine summary
- [Email](mailto:hello@petdate.ir): hello at petdate.ir
- [Telegram bot](https://t.me/Petdatebot): Petdatebot
